main.description: A Zena package's profile. A package is an atproto account, and its repository has one profile.

name.description: The local name the package suggests for itself, and the first label of its handle. It is one DNS label: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter, not ending with '-', and without '--' as its third and fourth characters. 'zena' names the standard library and is not allowed.

homepage.description: An http: or https: URL. A host refuses a profile with any other, and readers treat one as absent.

source.description: The http: or https: URL of the repository the package is developed in. A host refuses a profile with any other, and readers treat one as absent.
